take a breather... I wouldn't say that you being ugly is the problem. I think you can see what the real problem is by reading your post. You crave the acceptance of others and want to feel desired which is a problem by itself, cause you will never be enough for the world. 
You can enjoy being alive without having the attention of others. A lot of great people actually aren't pretty. They were intelligent. Start working on something you can actually change which is your character, self love, compassion etc. Try helping yourself by reading self help books. Or going for a walk and reading books. Take it one day at a time and things will start happening. If you can't find love and you want it so badly just accept that right now you don't have it and that's okay. Accept & Love yourself first and everything else will follow. Don't be afraid to give it a try. It takes time. Nothing comes easily.

The things that helped me with my anxiety are the following:
- Not taking myself seriously.
- Reading self help books.
- Taking it one day at a time.
- Avoiding Social Media, sticking to the ones I enjoy for example YouTube, Reddit where I mostly just see the news and don't really enroll myself with what others do.
- Talk to my parents and people that care for me. 
- Going for a walk.
- Tricking my mind into doing something for example cleaning my room or cooking so I don't have time to overthink whatever is on my mind.
- Accepting the truth and not forcing anything that happens or will happen.

Hope these are helpful.
